zh_CN: 玩具由 App 控制中
玩具断开了，进度已保留。
en: The toy is disconnected. Your progress is saved.

zh_CN: 请按屏幕提示调整玩具。
en: Adjust the toy as shown on the screen.

zh_CN: 语言包还没准备好，手机会继续提示。
en: The voice pack is not ready. Your phone will provide prompts.

zh_CN: 把提示中的卡放到指定区域。
en: Place the card shown in the marked area.

zh_CN: 把玩具旋钮调到提示档位。
en: Turn the toy dial to the level shown.

zh_CN: 按提示打开或关上玩具烤箱门。
en: Open or close the toy oven door as shown.

zh_CN: 没有玩具也可以用屏幕完成。
en: You can finish on the screen without a toy.
Does not use an ingredient slot
Add water; it does not use an ingredient slot.
Water is added; it does not use an ingredient slot.

zh_CN: 这道菜不用放第三种食材
en: This dish does not need a third ingredient.
Choose a dish you like first.

zh_CN: 点亮着的食材，按顺序放好
en: Choose the highlighted ingredients in order.

zh_CN: 小火慢慢煮，大火要留心
en: Cook gently on low heat; watch high heat.
Wait a moment; the aroma is coming.
That is okay. Let's try again.

zh_CN: 这份料理已经绑定订单，请先完成或返回餐厅。
en: This dish is already linked to an order. Finish it or return to the restaurant.

zh_CN: 这份订单或配方暂时不可用，请返回餐厅再试。
en: This order or recipe is unavailable right now. Please return to the restaurant and try again.

zh_CN: 按步骤慢慢来，操作失误也可以重试。
en: Take it step by step. You can retry if you make a mistake.

zh_CN: 先按当前步骤来吧，食材仍然保留着。
en: Follow the current step first. Your ingredients are still here.

zh_CN: 已返回餐厅，这份料理尚未完成。
en: Back at the restaurant. This dish is not finished yet.

zh_CN: 已清空操作，可以重新选择这份配方的食材。
en: Cleared. Choose this recipe's ingredients again.

zh_CN: 食材和准备步骤都保留了，再来一次就好。
en: Your ingredients and preparation are saved. Just try again.

zh_CN: 三个食材位已经满了，可以清空后重新选择。
en: All three ingredient slots are full. Clear them to choose again.

zh_CN: 做得好，这份料理完成了！
en: Great job, this dish is ready!

zh_CN: 火候有点过头了，食材还在，可以轻松重试。
en: It cooked a little too long. Your ingredients remain, so you can easily retry.

zh_CN: 现在刚刚好，慢慢完成最后一步吧。
en: It is just right now. Finish the last step.

zh_CN: 依次加入咖啡、牛奶和冰块。
en: Add coffee, milk, and ice in that order.

zh_CN: 加入土豆、胡萝卜和清水；清水不占食材位。
en: Add potato, carrot, and water. Water does not use an ingredient slot.

zh_CN: 选择这份配方需要的食材。
en: Choose the ingredients this recipe needs.

zh_CN: 把番茄切一切，鸡蛋不用切。
en: Chop the tomato. The egg does not need chopping.

zh_CN: 把土豆和胡萝卜切成小块。
en: Chop the potato and carrot into small pieces.

zh_CN: 将准备好的食材放入烤箱。
en: Put the prepared ingredients in the oven.

zh_CN: 将准备好的食材放入汤锅。
en: Put the prepared ingredients in the pot.

zh_CN: 将准备好的食材放入炒锅。
en: Put the prepared ingredients in the pan.
Put the prepared ingredients in the {vessel}.

zh_CN: 选择小火、中火或大火，慢慢等它做好。
en: Choose low, medium, or high heat and wait for it to cook.
Baking now. Please wait a moment.
Heating now. Please wait a moment.

zh_CN: 已经做好了，取出烤盘吧。
en: It is ready. Take out the baking tray.
Give it a quick stir-fry to finish.

zh_CN: 汤已经煮好了，点击完成吧。
en: The soup is ready. Tap Finish.

zh_CN: 不用担心，保留食材重试，或清空重新准备。
en: Don't worry. Retry with the ingredients, or clear and start over.

zh_CN: 料理完成，返回餐厅继续送餐。
en: The dish is ready. Return to the restaurant to continue serving.

zh_CN: 已取消，这次不会完成订单。
en: Cancelled. This order will not be completed this time.

zh_CN: 选择一份订单开始料理。
en: Choose an order to start cooking.

zh_CN: 加入南瓜、玉米和清水；清水不占食材位。
en: Add pumpkin, corn, and water. Water does not use an ingredient slot.

zh_CN: 把南瓜和玉米切成小块。
en: Chop the pumpkin and corn into small pieces.

zh_CN: 蘑菇煎好了，翻面完成吧。
en: The mushrooms are ready. Flip to finish.
No dish has been selected yet.

zh_CN: {coins} 金币 · 招待 {served} 位 · 流失 {lost} 位

en: Tap the top right to continue.

zh_CN: 音乐开关：关闭时暂停，开启继续原进度
en: Music toggle: pauses when off and resumes from the same spot when on.

zh_CN: 音乐设置本次有效；原设置文件受保护或暂时无法保存。
en: Music settings apply this session only; the settings file is protected or cannot be saved right now.

zh_CN: 营业会自动保存，也可以手动保存（S）
en: Progress saves automatically. You can also save manually (S).

zh_CN: 已保护异常存档，本次不覆盖
en: Protected invalid save; it will not be overwritten.

zh_CN: 保存失败：厨房订单绑定异常
en: Save failed: kitchen order binding is invalid.

zh_CN: 营业进度已保存 · 独立多桌存档
en: Restaurant progress saved · separate multi-table save

zh_CN: 进度文件已保护 · 请查看设置
en: Progress file is protected · check Settings

zh_CN: 保存未成功 · 请查看设置
en: Save did not succeed · check Settings

zh_CN: 暂停 P · 保存 S · 确认点单 空格
en: Pause P · Save S · Confirm order Space

zh_CN: 点客人，点好单再去做饭
en: Tap a guest, confirm the order, then cook.

zh_CN: 找到等待点单或等待下厨的客人
en: Find a guest waiting to order or cook.

zh_CN: 确认点单并开始制作：{recipe}（空格）
点客人确认菜品，再去小厨房亲手做一份。
en: Tap a guest to confirm a dish, then make it yourself in the little kitchen.

zh_CN: 已恢复多桌营业进度，任务与付款记录一并恢复。
en: Restored multi-table progress, including tasks and payments.

zh_CN: 存档版本或内容异常，已保护原文件；本次不会覆盖保存。
en: The save version or contents are invalid. The original is protected and will not be overwritten.

zh_CN: 客人会自己进来，坐好后再帮他们点单。
en: Guests will come in on their own. Help them order once seated.

zh_CN: 点好啦，厨房会做好送来。
en: Order placed! The kitchen will prepare and deliver it.

zh_CN: 厨房进度异常，已保护原存档。
en: Kitchen progress is invalid. The original save is protected.

zh_CN: 餐厅先停一停，专心完成这份料理。
en: Pause the restaurant for now and focus on this dish.

zh_CN: 料理与当前订单不匹配，未送餐或计费。
en: The dish does not match the current order. It was not delivered or charged.

zh_CN: 做好啦！服务员会送餐、收款，再把桌子收拾好。
en: All done! Staff will serve it, collect payment, and clear the table.

zh_CN: 已返回餐厅，订单还在；点这位客人继续做饭。
en: Back at the restaurant. The order remains; tap this guest to continue cooking.

zh_CN: 已结清 {count} 桌，共收入 {coins} 金币。
熊主理人开始制作最早登记的订单。
en: The bear chef started the earliest recorded order.

zh_CN: 厨房正在制作，或还没有已登记的订单。
en: The kitchen is busy cooking, or there are no recorded orders yet.
A new guest has arrived at the door.

zh_CN: 队列或在店人数已满，请先招待现有客人。
en: The queue or restaurant is full. Please serve current guests first.

zh_CN: 自动分桌已{state}；可点击空桌安排队首客人。
en: Auto seating is {state}. Tap a free table to seat the first guest in line.

zh_CN: 新的在店上限只影响后续进店，不会赶走已有客人。
en: The new capacity only affects future arrivals; current guests will not be removed.

zh_CN: 开发控制 · 玩家模式下只读
en: Developer controls · read-only in player mode

zh_CN: 开发面板 · F3 关闭
正常游戏由你点单、亲手做饭。\n送餐、收款与清桌会自动完成。
en: In normal play, you order and cook yourself.\nServing, payment, and clearing happen automatically.
